_comment: 2026-07-26 main-quest restructure (Task 2.3): the Horns' camp at the ruin, attached to ruin_surface's `ceria_dig_camp` NPC. This is a SEPARATE graph file, not extra nodes inside ceria_intro.json, because a conversation graph is one file (game.gd keys dialogue_graphs by basename) and always opens at its own `start` -- there is no per-entity start-node override, so camp_hub could never be reached through ceria_intro's hub. The split is also what the place-naming validator wants: the horns_dig GIVER maps (ceria_intro: inn + dungeon_approach) stay disjoint from the join_dig PRODUCER map (ruin_surface), so quests.json's join_dig beat is held to naming the ruin. SPOILER RULE: no line here names a door; the reveal is the pedestal's open_toast. The door_retrieved text_variant is the past-tense arm migrated saves see (spec section 8).

camp_hub.speaker: Ceria
camp_hub.text: You made it. Camp rules: nobody touches anything shiny, nobody wanders past the survey stakes alone. The sealed level's below the pedestal court. We found the site off an old expedition ledger -- half the pages were about what they DIDN'T bring out.

text_variants.text: Still can't believe we carried that thing across the floodplains. Erin's already put a tablecloth on it. A TABLECLOTH.
